violations.why: The ISR can preempt main between the writes at 38 and 40 and read the intermediate value 0x09, which is never meant to be seen.
The ISR can read the value 0x01 after the write at 32 and before the final write at 40, and the main flow is not protected by masking.
The ISR can read the intermediate value between the write at 32 and the conditional write at 38.
